fixtures.description: Six pink letter strokes and two blue accents apart on transparency: the pink is under 3:1 on pastels and the blue on Navy.
A cream disc inside a dark brown ring: the cream vanishes on light garments but the ring frames it.
The same cream disc with no outline: lost on light garments.
Cream panels outlined in dark browns beside dark green leaves.
Black letter blocks with orange inlays: legible on light garments, lost on dark ones.
A black square at 55% opacity: laid over the garment it reads more faintly than solid black.
A 2400 px canvas with a pale panel in an 8 px black outline holding black lettering, measured with its content bounds: wider than 1024 px, so sampling and cropping are exercised.

The two-tone lettering distressed: a third of each ink's pixels shifted up to 14 per channel, worn and half-transparent pixels, and alpha 1 to 6 residue of any color over half the canvas. Every pixel of a replaced ink must change, and the residue must not count against a recolor.
